scientific_rationale: Activate the frozen Analyst selection without substitution. The reward is a robust partial point-cloud imitation proxy over the Analyst-selected spatial slots 5,8,11,14,23, with equal normalized weights 0.2 each, evaluated against the verified real current-state ancestor at teacher clock 0.5 (candidate F_b011_s030, batch 11, ancestor_slot 37, terminal_slot 30, terminal_score 8.704806327819824, parent_copy_verified true). The selected slots are the union of P015 (5,8,11,14) and P017 (8,11,14,23); P015 and P017 are adjacent 4-slot extents sharing 8,11,14, so the union tests the Analyst hypothesis that positive incremental regional affinity association, not raw whole-pose similarity, is the useful spatial constraint. The free complement (slots 0,1,2,3,4,6,7,9,10,12,13,15,16,17,18,19,20,21,22,24) remains unconstrained, so the reward specifies localized spatial organization rather than a whole-pose template. Generated atom correspondence is a spatial assignment, not teacher slot indices; teacher indices are not generated atom indices. The teacher-clock bridge includes the current-coordinate identity derivative and the real FLOWR coordinate Jacobian. Gradient ascent lowers distance error and increases the negative reward toward zero. The affinity head is not differentiated and no particle resampling is introduced; native chemical graph transitions remain free. Local direct loss excludes unmatched points, but model-mediated forces can reach other current coordinates, so actual displacement and the unguided suffix must be recorded. Loss reduction is implementation feedback only; final affinity and actual valid structures decide whether the reward works. The frozen dose (max_atom_step_A 0.15, max_cumulative_rms_A 6.0, native_rms_ratio 0.33, pointcloud_delta_A 1.0) is applied unchanged. Because the P015 and P017 cluster95 intervals include zero, this is an unresolved association to be tested by terminal feedback, not a proven causal effect.
